name: 2Chat
description: 2Chat lets agents read WhatsApp and SMS conversations, look up and add contacts, and draft replies on the 2Chat numbers of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own 2Chat account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize the WhatsApp conversations that have no reply yet.
Add a contact for Ana Ruiz with her phone number and company.
Draft a reply to the last message from this customer about the delivery date.

apps.name: 2Chat
apps.description: WhatsApp, SMS, contact, and call tools, over 2Chat's MCP server with browser sign-in.
